items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: I go to Mo Gale and tell him, I said, 'Man, I can't give you fifty percent of my earnings.'

ctx.x: So he was in on fifty percent of that?
He was in on fifty percent of that. So after I'd made all this money, I go to Mo Gale and tell him, I said, "Man, I can't give you fifty percent of my earnings."
